title: AutoPlay settings
description: settings.json (in %LOCALAPPDATA%\AutoPlay): settings of the application, shared by all profiles.

theme.description: Color theme: follows Windows, or forced light or dark.

stopWithEscape.description: Whether Esc stops a run (F12 always does).

quickCaptureEnabled.description: Whether the quick capture shortcut is active.

quickCaptureHotkey.description: Shortcut of the quick capture, e.g. Ctrl+Shift+F9.

dataFolder.description: Folder of the profiles; null for %LOCALAPPDATA%\AutoPlay\Profiles.
